name: GOODBYE GOODBYE
source:
Your sense stretches, pulls thin, until it burns. Annoyance coils in your chest – the inescapable feeling of being watched.

This is not an ordinary place.

[From [url=https://pokaji-kichki.itch.io/goodbye-goodbye]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的感觉被拉伸、变薄，直到燃烧。烦恼在你的胸中盘旋——不可避免的被监视的感觉。

这不是一个普通的地方。

[来自[url=https://pokaji-kichki.itch.io/goodbye-goodbye]Itch.io[/url]]
